Apple updated the "Apple iPhone Repair and Service" support page, listing the repair costs for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, with battery replacement prices being increased. The following are the details.

iPhone 18 Pro battery replacement costs $10 more

According to MacRumors, Apple has set the battery service fee for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max at US$129 on its official website, which is US$10 more than the US$119 for the iPhone 16 Pro, iPhone 16 Pro Max, iPhone 17 Pro, and iPhone 17 Pro Max.

The US$129 fee applies to out-of-warranty repair services. Apple stated that it will "inspect your device to determine the final service fee".

The following is the complete repair cost table for the iPhone 18 Pro:

  • Battery service: US$129
  • Rear glass damage: US$159
  • Rear camera damage: US$249
  • Screen damage: US$329
  • Screen and rear glass damage: US$419
  • Other damage: US$849

The following is the complete repair cost table for the iPhone 18 Pro Max:

  • Screen damage: US$379
  • Screen and rear glass damage: US$469
  • Other damage: US$899

According to the technical specifications for the new iPhones published by Apple in the EU, the iPhone 18 Pro is equipped with a 4,056 mAh battery, while the iPhone 18 Pro Max is equipped with a 5,391 mAh battery, representing an increase over the 3,988 mAh and 4,823 mAh of the iPhone 17 Pro and iPhone 17 Pro Max respectively.
